decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to use the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire library, while utilizing cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to recur important pieces. The deck also features strong mana acceleration and protection with cards like Lotus Petal, Force of Will, and Mox Opal, allowing for a quick and efficient setup to execute the win condition. Additionally, Urza's Saga provides a versatile toolbox of artifacts to further support the combo strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly filling your graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back to the battlefield for a game-winning combo. Using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, you can cheat out high-cost creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game. With counter spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect your combo pieces, as well as disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board, you aim to overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures before they can react effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent through cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Delver of Secrets while disrupting their game plan with cards like Wasteland and Daze. The deck aims to maintain card advantage and control the board with counterspells like Force of Will and Unholy Heat, while leveraging powerful threats like Murktide Regent to close out the game. By efficiently managing resources and applying early pressure, the deck looks to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in order to secure victories.

The main focus of this deck is using lands as a resource to control the game. By utilizing cards like Crop Rotation, Mox Diamond, and Thespian's Stage, the deck aims to quickly assemble powerful land combinations such as Dark Depths with Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. Cards like The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale and Wasteland are used to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Life from the Loam helps to recur key lands and provide card advantage. These control elements give the deck a strong advantage in the late game.

This Canadian Threshold aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ponder to dig for threats and disruption, the deck aims to maintain card advantage and tempo advantage throughout the game. Additionally, by including cards like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base and heavy hitters like Murktide Regent, the deck is able to close out games quickly and decisively.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, while also using aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and Fury to quickly close out the game. Additionally, the deck utilizes artifact ramp like Chrome Mox and City of Traitors to accelerate its game plan, along with powerful removal spells like Sundering Eruption to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and force the opponent to adapt to its disruptive game plan.

The deck focuses on using lands to control the opponent's resources and disrupt their game plan. By utilizing cards like Wasteland and Ghost Quarter to destroy opponent's lands, along with the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a powerful 20/20 indestructible creature, the deck seeks to lock down the opponent's board while building its own advantage. Cards like Life from the Loam and Once Upon a Time help to find the necessary pieces, while Crop Rotation and Boseiju, Who Endures provide flexibility and protection. Overall, the deck seeks to grind out the opponent and control the game through its powerful land interactions.

This deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures into play by putting them into the graveyard and then reanimating them. The deck includes cards like Thoughtseize, Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to set up the combo. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Cabal Therapy while quickly assembling a powerful board presence with creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Valgavoth, Terror Eater. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Thundertrap Trainer provide card advantage and additional control options to help secure the win.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, and then bringing them back into play with Reanimate and Animate Dead. The strategy centers around reanimating expensive, game-winning creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent early in the game, overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, as well as card draw and filtering with Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency and efficiency in executing the combo.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead to overwhelm the opponent with big threats. The deck includes disruption and protection spells like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to prevent the opponent from stopping the combo. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

The deck revolves around quickly and efficiently milling out your entire library and then using Thassa's Oracle to win the game. It has a variety of ways to generate mana, draw cards, and protect your combo, while also having some disruption tools to control the opponent's strategy. The goal is to assemble the necessary pieces as quickly as possible and execute the combo before the opponent can disrupt your plans. This deck is high-risk, high-reward and requires precise sequencing and decision-making to achieve victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game tempo by disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Daze, while also being aggressive with creatures like Nethergoyf and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to quickly apply pressure on the opponent while utilizing cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the necessary answers. The inclusion of powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Nihil Spellbomb help the deck stay ahead in the game. Wasteland is also included to disrupt the opponent's mana base, further cementing the deck's tempo-focused strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient spells to control the board while pressuring the opponent with aggressive creatures. The main strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, while also using cards like Daze and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats. The tempo of the game is maintained through card selection with Preordain, Ponder, and Brainstorm, as well as the use of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Bauble for additional value. The key is to outmaneuver the opponent while consistently applying pressure with creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Griselbrand, then bring them back onto the battlefield with reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck aims to assemble a game-winning board state as quickly as possible, making it a potent combo deck that can overwhelm opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck aims to quickly and efficiently combo off by milling the entire library and then winning the game with Thassa's Oracle. It utilizes cards like Balustrade Spy, Undercity Informer, and Boggart Trawler to mill the deck, while also using cards like Dark Ritual and Simian Spirit Guide to generate mana quickly. Pact of Negation protects the combo from disruption, while Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize help to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck is designed to win as fast as possible, often winning on the first turn.

This UWx Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells. It also utilizes powerful threats like Roiling Dragonstorm, Reanimate, and various creatures to control the game and secure victory. The diverse land base allows for flexibility in mana production and disruption through Wasteland. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent, while maintaining control of the board and hand to dictate the pace of the game.
